source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: 844 waits 2000 ms because the stored timestamp can be truncated to seconds and the test must detect a wrong replacement with a later current time. That purpose is concrete. The 829 compose test instead documents an uncertain 100 ms readiness workaround. State the clock or event condition a wait protects; do not promote either delay as a general test style or claim a focus wait removes unrelated readiness needs.
title: Distinguish a clock-boundary wait from an unexplained readiness sleep
